name: Whole-body cryostimulation in a three-chamber cryo-room: precooling at -30 C and -60 C then 3-4 min at -110 C, twice weekly
plain_name: Give a patient a short session in an extremely cold therapy room
description: Clinical-trial adjunct to obesity management: 28 supervised whole-body cryotherapy sessions in a Univers Cryo-Combi three-chamber system, brief precooling at -30 C and -60 C followed by 3-4 min at -110 C; the person breathes the cold air at ambient pressure.
keywords: Give a patient a short session in an extremely cold therapy room

sources.citation: Karppinen JE et al. Effects of Whole-Body Cryotherapy Combined With Conventional Obesity Management Versus Obesity Management Alone: A Clinical Trial. Obesity 2025. DOI 10.1002/oby.70019

Ritter H et al. Analgesia by Cryotherapy in Patients with Chronic Pain with Analysis of Pain-Modulating and Pro-Inflammatory Parameters - A Clinical Controlled Pilot Study. J Clin Med 2025. DOI 10.3390/jcm14217567

reported_equipment: three-chamber WBC system (Univers Cryo-Combi, Oy MJG Univers Ab, Helsinki, Finland)
in-house cryochamber (three rooms, Helios Vogelsang Gommern Specialist Hospital)

requirements.rationale: The chamber system must provide -30 C and -60 C precooling and the -110 C treatment chamber.
The patient is exposed to cold air; an evacuated sample space cannot host a person.
Treatment-chamber temperature of about -110 C (second clinical source, chronic-pain patients).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
